name: supertrend_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 2-minute SuperTrend (ATR period=24 bars at 5s, multiplier=3.0) defines a dynamic ATR-based support/resistance channel. When NIFTY price pierces this channel and SuperTrend flips direction, algorithmic strategies — especially those deployed by retail traders on Zerodha Kite where SuperTrend(10, 3.0) is the platform default indicator — detect the same signal and cascade directional market orders. Since NIFTY futures and options are India's most heavily algo-traded instruments, a SuperTrend flip aligned with VWAP (confirming macro session direction) triggers a self-reinforcing 15-60 second momentum burst as momentum algos pile in before the burst exhausts. We enter at the first 5-second confirmation bar and exit within 90 seconds before mean reversion begins.

indicators.name: atr_24
indicators.formula: ATR(high, low, close, period=24) — Wilder's smoothed ATR
indicators.purpose: 2-minute ATR window (24 × 5s = 120s). NOT the original's blindly-scaled 10×12=120 bars (10 min). We use 2 minutes because we hold 15-90s — the ATR channel must reflect the CURRENT micro-volatility regime, not a 10-minute history. A 2-min ATR is tight enough to produce flip signals aligned with our hold horizon while being wide enough to avoid single-bar noise.

indicators.name: supertrend_24
indicators.formula: SuperTrend(period=24, multiplier=3.0): final_upper = min(HL2 + 3*ATR, prev_upper) if prev_close <= prev_upper; final_lower = max(HL2 - 3*ATR, prev_lower) if prev_close >= prev_lower; direction=1 when close > final_upper, -1 when close < final_lower
indicators.purpose: SuperTrend direction (1=bullish, -1=bearish) is the primary flip signal. Multiplier=3.0 is preserved exactly from the original — this is the Zerodha Kite default setting, so it maximises the Schelling-point crowd effect. If we used a non-standard multiplier, we would be trading against the crowd rather than with it.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: VWAP = cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) reset at 09:15 IST each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP as macro direction filter. Long signals only above VWAP (demand side has dominated since open), short signals only below VWAP (supply side dominant). No lookback scaling needed — VWAP is cumulative and session-anchored by definition.

indicators.name: volume_ratio_60
indicators.formula: volume / SMA(volume, 60) — ratio of current 5s bar volume to 5-minute rolling mean
indicators.purpose: 5-minute volume baseline (60 × 5s = 300s) rather than the original's 20-minute baseline. We need to detect elevated volume vs the RECENT past because NIFTY volume has strong intraday patterns (high at open/close, low at midday). A 5-min rolling mean adapts to these patterns and confirms genuine institutional participation on the flip bar.

conditions: st_direction[i] == 1 AND st_direction[i-1] == -1 (SuperTrend just flipped bullish this bar)
close > vwap (above session anchor — institutional buy-side has been dominant)
volume_ratio_60 > vol_ratio_threshold (elevated volume confirms participation, not noise flip)
buy_ce.confirmation: First 5s bar of bullish SuperTrend flip with VWAP and volume alignment

conditions: st_direction[i] == -1 AND st_direction[i-1] == 1 (SuperTrend just flipped bearish this bar)
close < vwap (below session anchor — institutional sell-side has been dominant)
volume_ratio_60 > vol_ratio_threshold (elevated volume confirms participation, not noise flip)
buy_pe.confirmation: First 5s bar of bearish SuperTrend flip with VWAP and volume alignment

exit.stop_rationale: If the SuperTrend flip is genuine, NIFTY should not retrace more than 8 spot points within 30s of the flip — that equals ~4 option points at ATM delta 0.5. A 4-pt option loss means an 8-pt spot reversal which signals the ATR channel break was false and the thesis is invalidated.
exit.target_rationale: SuperTrend-triggered momentum bursts on NIFTY push 12-18 spot points within 30-60s as cascading algo orders follow the flip. 6 option points (~12 spot pts at delta 0.5) captures the initial burst at 1:1.5 R:R before the move decelerates and mean-reversion pressure builds.

filters.vix_filter: none — SuperTrend adapts dynamically via ATR, inherently adjusting stop width to volatility regime
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; first 5 minutes (09:15-09:20) excluded to avoid pre-market gap noise
filters.volume_filter: volume_ratio_60 > vol_ratio_threshold (default 1.3) on the flip bar
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment: buy CE only when close > VWAP, buy PE only when close < VWAP
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close
filters.whipsaw_filter: implicit via SuperTrend ATR-band hysteresis — price must cross the full 3*ATR channel to trigger a flip

edge.edge_decay_risk: Moderate — SuperTrend crowding is real but the VWAP + volume filter removes low-conviction flips, leaving only high-participation flips where the crowd effect is strongest

adaptation_notes: Original uses SuperTrend(10, 3.0) on 1-min bars of NIFTY200 stocks. Converted to 5s NIFTY index by: (1) ATR period compressed from 10 min to 2 min (24 bars) — we hold 15-90s not 10-30 min, so the channel must reflect current micro-volatility; (2) Universe changed from NIFTY200 stocks to NIFTY index — the Schelling-point effect applies at least as strongly to NIFTY since it is India's most traded instrument by algo count; (3) Volume lookback reduced from 20 min to 5 min (60 bars) — captures recent participation patterns rather than historical baseline; (4) Multiplier 3.0 preserved exactly — this is the Zerodha Kite default and is the specific crowd coordination point; (5) VWAP filter preserved conceptually — same direction-alignment logic.
weaknesses: At 5s bars, SuperTrend flips can occur multiple times per minute during choppy NIFTY sessions despite the ATR buffer
The retail-crowd self-fulfilling thesis is weaker on NIFTY index than on individual stocks where retail concentration is higher
On high-VIX days (>20), ATR expands dramatically and SuperTrend flips become rarer but also less reliable as the ATR channel is too wide
